section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Corporation tax [national]
value: 12.5% on trading income; 25% on non-trading income and excepted trades; 15% minimum effective rate (domestic top-up tax) for groups and standalone entities with revenue over €750,000,000. Paid by companies resident in Ireland, and non-resident companies trading through an Irish branch or agency. Taxes Consolidation Act 1997; Part 4A for the top-up taxes.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, USC, PRSI and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: Revenue: Corporation Tax (CT), Basis of charge (published 16 October 2026); Corporation Tax (CT), Overview (published 16 October 2026)

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Tax on distributed profits and branch profits [national]
value: branch profits: corporation tax at the same rates; distributions: 25% Dividend Withholding Tax; close companies: 20% surcharge on undistributed investment and estate income (15% on half of professional and service income). Paid by companies (DWT is withheld from the shareholder's dividend). Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 Part 6 Chapter 8A (DWT), sections 440 and 441 (surcharges).
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, USC, PRSI and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Self-employed contributions: PRSI Class S [national]
value: 4.2% to 30 September 2026, 4.35% from 1 October 2026 (4.2375% for 2026 income in self-assessment), minimum €650. Paid by self-employed people with income of €5,000 or more. Social Welfare Consolidation Act 2005, Part 2 Chapter 3. In force from 1 January 2026.
note: This list covers corporate tax, self-employment and contractor rules, non-resident pay and property taxes; income tax, USC, PRSI and VAT are in the sections above. Each row has its own official source.

label: Relevant Contracts Tax (RCT) [national]

value: no VAT registration below €42,500 (services) or €85,000 (goods) of turnover; VAT on cash received up to €2,000,000 turnover; flat-rate addition of 4.5% for unregistered farmers. Paid by small businesses and farmers that use them. Value-Added Tax Consolidation Act 2010.

section: Taxes and charges: corporate, contractor, non-resident and property
label: Non-resident tax on employment income [national]
value: income tax at the normal rates, collected through PAYE, on pay for duties performed in Ireland; tax credits in full or in part only for EU citizens and treaty-country citizens. Paid by non-resident employees (withheld by the employer, including foreign employers). Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 section 819 (residence), sections 984 and 985C to 985F (PAYE). In force from 1 January 2020.
